request.style: English, female soul voice, gospel choir, piano, organ, drums, bass, uplifting and warm, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
If you remain in me and my words remain in you
Ask whatever you wish and it will be done for you
This is how my Father is glorified in your life
Bear much fruit and prove you are my disciples

[Pre-Chorus]
As the Father has loved me with a love so true
So I have loved you as well in every view

[Chorus]
Remain in my love and let your heart be still
Keep my commandments and walk with me a while
I have told you this so that my joy may be in you
And your joy may be complete and new

[Verse]
If you keep my commandments you will remain in my love
Just as I have kept my Father's commandments above
I remain in his love and he remains in me
This is the path that I freely give to see

[Chorus]
Remain in my love and let your heart be still
Keep my commandments and walk with me a while
I have told you this so that my joy may be in you
And your joy may be complete and new

[Chorus]
Remain in my love and let your heart be still
Keep my commandments and walk with me a while
I have told you this so that my joy may be in you
And your joy may be complete and new

[Bridge]
This is my commandment that you love one another
As I have loved you without end or another
No one has greater love than to lay down his life
For his friends who are called to this holy life

[Outro]
You are my friends if you do what I command
Remain in my love and hold my loving hand
